title: Star Trek #6 Marvel 1980 Enterprise Murder Case Dave Cockrum Mike W. Barr Kirk
conditionDescription: Spine and edge wear with small chips at the right edge of the front cover; back cover toned. See photos.
descriptionText:
Star Trek #6 (September 1980), Marvel Comics - "The Enterprise Murder Case!" Ambassador Phral beams up alive and arrives dead. Written by Mike W. Barr, art by Dave Cockrum and Klaus Janson; cover by Cockrum and Janson. 50 cent cover price.

Back cover: Olympic Sales Club prizes ad.

Condition: spine and edge wear with small chips along the right edge of the front cover; back cover toned (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
